verses.text: Ha t'a yichb'anel, ha Dios ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' lum lum.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' malaj stzolal yaj jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik, tzinan yilji. Tonhej panhan ek' ha ha' t'a yib'anh lu'um. K'ik'olinak yilji masanil t'a yib'anh ha', haxo Yespíritu Dios tzek' t'a yib'anh ha' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' sakil k'inal, xchi. Icha chi' b'i'an ix sakb'i k'inal.
Ix yilan Dios to wach' jun sakil k'inal chi', ix spojanel sakil k'inal chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal.
Ha sakil k'inal chi', k'uhalil ix sb'iejkan yuj, haxo k'ik' k'inal chi', t'ak'walil ix sb'iejkani. Ix k'ik'b'iemi, ix sakb'i, ix ek'el jun b'ab'el k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' junok tas skan t'a yib'anh sat lu'um tik yik spojan snanhal ha ha', xchi.
Icha chi' b'i'an, ha Dios ixb'o'an jun chi'. Cha makan ix ajkanel ha ha' chi' yuj: Jun makan ha' ix kan t'a sat lum tik, junxo makan ha' ix k'ekan t'a yib'anh. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha jun ix kan chi' “satcha'anh” ix sb'iejkani. Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schab'il k'uhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Junxonhejokab' tz'aj ha ha' ay t'a yalanh satcha'anh yik scheklajkan lum lum t'a takinhal, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ha b'aj ix cheklajkan stak'inhal chi', “lu'um” ix sb'iejkani, haxo ha ha' junnhej ix aj chi', “mar” ix sb'iejkan ha'. Haxo ix yilan Dios chi', te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan icha tik: Pak'okab' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum yet' te te' syak' sat. Ha t'a sat te' chi' yet' anh ank'ultak chi', hata' ay yinhatil hato syala' tas makanhil, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spak' anh ank'ultak t'a sat lum lum tik, haton anh ank'ultak yet' te te' syak' sat hato syala' tas inhatil. Haxo ix yilan Dios te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yoxil k'uhal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ayokab' juntzanh sakil k'inal t'a satcha'anh yik syak' sakil k'inal t'a sat lu'um tik, yik sch'oxanel k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil, yik scheklaj junjun k'u, junjun ab'il yet' juntzanh tiempo'al, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji.

Ha Dios ixb'o'an chab' niwak sakil k'inal. Ha jun niwan sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'a k'uhalil, haxo jun kennhej sk'ak'al ix och yopisio t'ak'walil, haton k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ix sb'oanpax masanil k'e'en k'anal.
Ix yak'anoch juntzanh sakil k'inal chi' t'a satcha'anh yik syak' yok t'a sat lu'um tik
t'a k'uhalil yet' t'ak'walil yuj spojanpaxel sakil k'inal t'a k'ik' k'inal. Ix yilan Dios chi' te wach' ix aji.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' schanhil k'uhal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' nok' nok', nok' ay t'a yol ha ha' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much tzek' jenhenhok, xchi.
Ix sb'o'an nok' niwak nok' Dios chi', nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a yol ha' chi' yet' masanil makanhil nok' much. Haxo ix yilani te wach' ix aji.

Ix yak'an swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh nok' nok' chi', ix yalan icha tik: Yune'ejokab' sb'a nok', k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok', b'ut'jokab'el yol ha' mar yuj nok'. Hanhejtona' nok' much, k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, xchi.
Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' yo'il k'uhal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Pitzwokab' cha'anh masanil makan nok' nok' t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um, xchi. Ichaton chi' ix aji, ix sb'o'an masanil makanhil nok' nok' ay t'a sat lu'um tik. Ix yilani, te wach' ix aji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Dios icha tik: Ha tikne'ik ko b'o'ek anima icha onh tik yik wach' tz'och heb' yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' mar, t'a yib'anh masanil nok' much, t'a yib'anh nok' molb'etzal nok', t'a yib'anh nok' k'ultakil nok' yet' pax t'a yib'anh nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um tik, xchi.
Ichato chi' ix b'oji heb' anima chi' yuj Dios, icha wal Dios chi' ix aj heb'. Ix b'ojikan winh winak yet' ix ix yuj.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh heb'. Ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: Aljokab' eyuninal, k'ib'okab' he b'isul, b'ut'jokab'el sat lum lum tik eyu'uj, ochanhek yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ochanhek yajalil t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha', t'a yib'anh nok' much sjenhwi yet' t'a yib'anh masanil nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lum tik, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha in swak' masanil makanhil anh ank'ultak ay yinhatil yet' masanil te te' syak' sat he lo'o yik syak' yip t'a he niwanil.

Masanil nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' tzek' nhernhonok ma tzek' jachjon t'a sat lu'um yet' nok' much, a in swak' anh ank'ultak yet' xiltak te te' swaelok nok', xchi. Icha chi' ix aji.
Ix yilanoch Dios, te wach' ix aj masanil tas ix sb'o'o. Ix k'ik'b'ixiemi, ix sakb'ixi, ix ek' swakil k'uhal.
